name: Quota Manager
description: Function-level API quota tracker: check, register, reset access limits with daily/weekly/monthly/yearly cycles. SQLite-backed (A6).
description_cn: 函数级 API 配额追踪：日/周/月/年/永久周期的访问限额检查、注册、重置。SQLite 持久化（A6）。

directives.description: Check and consume one quota unit for target. Returns ok with remaining count, or stop when exhausted. Atomic: cycle-reset + consume in one SQL statement.
directives.description_cn: 检查并消耗目标的一次配额。返回 ok（含剩余次数）或 stop（已耗尽）。原子操作：周期翻转检测+消耗一步完成。

params_desc.target: Quota target identifier, e.g. AI:inference / zhipu_key / image;generate

directives.usage_cn: 配额;注册,<追踪目标>,<周期>,<限额>
directives.description: Register a new quota tracking rule. Cycle: day(日)/week(周)/month(月)/year(年)/forever(永久).
directives.description_cn: 注册新的配额追踪规则。周期：日/周/月/年/永久。

params_desc.cycle: Reset cycle: day(日) / week(周) / month(月) / year(年) / forever(永久)

directives.description: List all registered quota rules with current usage and remaining counts.
directives.description_cn: 列出所有已注册配额规则及其当前使用量和剩余次数。

directives.description: Manually reset the usage counter for a target. Admin-only operation.
directives.description_cn: 手动重置目标的当前使用计数。管理员操作。

directives.description: Remove a quota tracking rule. Does not delete historical data.
directives.description_cn: 移除配额追踪规则，不删除历史数据。
